name: slipcard-anki
description: Use the Anki collection on your Slipcard Anki server from Claude: decks, notes, cards and reviews, through the server's MCP.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the MCP server of a [Slipcard](https://github.com/petroladkin/slipcard) Anki server on your network (docs/server.md). The extension asks for the server's MCP address when it is installed, for example `http://192.0.2.10:3141/mcp/` or `https://anki.example.com/mcp/`, and passes Claude's requests to it. The server has no API key: install this only for a server on a network you trust.

server_url.title: Anki server MCP address
server_url.description: The MCP address of your Slipcard Anki server, ending in /mcp/: for example http://192.0.2.10:3141/mcp/ (plain HTTP in your network) or https://anki.example.com/mcp/ (with the server's HTTPS).
